title: Henry Schein Announces Leadership Transitions
summary: Company to Create the Henry Schein Leadership Team to Replace its Executive Management Committee Three Executives to Become Senior Advisors Effective October 31, 2026 Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC) announced today that it is creating the Henry Schein Leadership Team (HSLT) to replace its Executive Management Committee. The Company will also integrate its global supply chain organization with its global distribution group.
